summary: Cadeler A/S filed a 6-K containing Kroll, LLC's independent statement, substituting for the board's formal statement under Section 6-16 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act, on the voluntary offer by Cadeler plc to acquire all Cadeler shares in connection with a redomiciliation from Denmark to the United Kingdom. Eligible holders exchange each DKK 1.00 Cadeler share, or ADS representing four shares, for one Cadeler plc share. Kroll concluded the consideration is fair from a financial point of view as of 21 September 2026. The offer document and EU/EEA prospectus were published 21 September 2026. Key watch items: acceptance thresholds, Norwegian regulatory clock, and whether the one-for-one exchange reflects Cadeler's full value.
